create_falia_bria_config: create a FalAIBriaConfig instance to configure the Bria Text-to-Image 3.2 model endpoint
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI parameters for the Bria 3.2 text-to-image model
map_openai_params_to_bria: map OpenAI image generation parameters like size and response_format to Bria 3.2 parameters
transform_image_generation_request: transform an image generation request into a Bria 3.2 request body with prompt and aspect ratio
transform_image_generation_response: transform a Bria 3.2 API response into a litellm ImageResponse format with image URLs
